title: EngagementRate V1
description: Deterministic engagement-rate result for a public Instagram profile or supplied Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube average metrics.

request_surface.description: Product entry point represented by this result.

input_mode.description: Whether metrics came from public Connector data or user-supplied averages.

aggregation_method.description: Statistic used for likes and comments before calculating the rate.

interaction_scope.description: Interactions included in both rate formulas.

sample_size.description: Number of calculable posts for public-profile mode; null for pre-aggregated manual input.

likes.description: Median or average likes, as declared by aggregation_method.

comments.description: Median or average comments, as declared by aggregation_method.

views.description: Average views when available; context only for Instagram public-profile mode.

view_engagement_rate_percent.description: (likes + comments) / compatible views * 100 when views exist; null when the sample has no play or view count.

basis.description: Benchmark family. YouTube grades the view rate only.

tier.description: Follower tier for public Instagram; null for broad manual bands and YouTube view bands.

rating.description: Machine-readable verdict. YouTube uses published view-rate labels.

label.description: Short display label for the follower-rate verdict.

matched_minimum_percent.description: Inclusive lower bound matched by this result, when the benchmark exposes one.

limitations.description: Optional caveats that must reach the short explanation. Omit when none apply.

sensitivity.description: Optional alternate rates. Never replace the default metrics.

view_engagement_rate_excluding_highest_p.description: Same formula after dropping one highest-play post. Sensitivity only.

sample_size_excluding_highest_play.description: Calculable posts remaining after that drop.
